title: create packages/instantsearch
body:
Following #1235, implement the `instantsearch` package inside `packages/instantsearch`.

Goals:
- implement all react-instantsearch widgets automatically
- provide a string/function based templating method (react-instantsearch supports only React components, by design)
- npm start inside packages/instantsearch should demonstrate it works
- see https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/f8a2ec3eeb2246f67efbbadb2194059f492952f9/packages/react-instantsearch/src/core/instantsearchV2.js and https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/f8a2ec3eeb2246f67efbbadb2194059f492952f9/packages/examples/isv2.js
- uses preact
